title: gc maintenance status --json result
description: Dolt store maintenance loop state and recent run history.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this command output.

_cache_age_s.description: Age in seconds of the supervisor status cache that produced this read.

interval_seconds.description: Configured scheduling interval in seconds (0 when disabled).

in_flight.description: True when a maintenance cycle is currently running.

in_flight_start.description: RFC3339 start time of the in-flight run, when one is running.

next_scheduled.description: RFC3339 approximate next scheduled run time.

history.description: Bounded ring of recent run outcomes (oldest first).

started_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the run began.

finished_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the run completed.

stage.description: Outcome stage: 'done' on success or 'backup'/'gc'/'smoke-test'/'prune' on failure.

err.description: Error message when stage names a failing phase; absent on success.

before_bytes.description: Store size in bytes before the run (0 when not measured).

after_bytes.description: Store size in bytes after the run (0 when not measured).

snapshot_path.description: Absolute path to the snapshot directory created for this run, when any.

duration_s.description: Elapsed wall-clock seconds between started_at and finished_at.
